modules.title: Introduction to The Exodus and the Covenant
modules.html:
Moses, the burning bush, the plagues, the Passover and the crossing of the Red Sea; the covenant at Sinai and the Ten Commandments. This section covers introduction to the exodus and the covenant.

Key points

  • The Ark of the Covenant was a symbol of God's _____ among the Israelites. — presence.
  • The 'New Covenant' was prophesied by _____. — Jeremiah.
  • The sign of the covenant between God and Noah was: — Rainbow.
  • The sign of God's covenant with Noah never to destroy the earth with water again was — The Rainbow.
  • The prophet who spoke of the "New Covenant" was — Jeremiah.

Worked examples

Q: The Ark of the Covenant was a symbol of God's _____ among the Israelites.
A: presence — The Ark represented the dwelling place and the constant presence of God with His people.

Q: The 'New Covenant' was prophesied by _____.
A: Jeremiah — Jeremiah 31:31 mentions the days when God would make a new covenant written on the hearts of people.

examples.q: The Ark of the Covenant was a symbol of God's _____ among the Israelites.

quiz.q: The Ark of the Covenant was a symbol of God's _____ among the Israelites.
quiz.solution: The Ark represented the dwelling place and the constant presence of God with His people.

quiz.q: The 'New Covenant' was prophesied by _____.
quiz.solution: Jeremiah 31:31 mentions the days when God would make a new covenant written on the hearts of people.

quiz.q: The sign of the covenant between God and Noah was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Rainbow.

quiz.q: The sign of God's covenant with Noah never to destroy the earth with water again was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: The Rainbow.

quiz.q: The prophet who spoke of the "New Covenant" was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Jeremiah.

quiz.q: The miracle of the feeding of the five thousand demonstrated Jesus as the _____.
quiz.solution: This miracle is often linked to Jesus' discourse on being the Bread that came down from heaven.

quiz.q: In the parable of the Prodigal Son, the father's reaction shows God's _____.
quiz.solution: The father running to meet the son illustrates God's eagerness to forgive and restore repentant sinners.

quiz.q: The first person to see the risen Christ according to Mark was _____.
quiz.solution: Mark 16:9 records that Jesus appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom He had cast seven demons.

quiz.q: Saul of Tarsus was converted on the road to _____.
quiz.solution: Saul was blinded by a great light and heard the voice of Jesus while traveling to Damascus to persecute Christians.

quiz.q: Paul's letter to Philemon was an appeal for the pardon of _____.
quiz.solution: Onesimus was a runaway slave who had become a Christian under Paul's ministry.

quiz.q: The person who helped Jesus carry the cross was _____.
quiz.solution: Simon of Cyrene, an African, was compelled by Roman soldiers to carry the cross.

quiz.q: Gideon defeated the Midianites with only _____ men.
quiz.solution: God reduced Gideon's army to 300 to show that the victory belonged to the Lord and not human strength.

quiz.q: The last book of the New Testament is _____.
quiz.solution: The Book of Revelation contains the apocalyptic visions of John regarding the end of the age.

quiz.q: Nehemiah's primary mission in Jerusalem was to _____.
options: rebuild the walls of the city
quiz.solution: Nehemiah was the cupbearer to the Persian king who obtained permission to return to Jerusalem to rebuild its broken walls.

quiz.q: In the parable of the Good Samaritan, the two religious figures who passed by the wounded man were a _____ and a _____.
quiz.solution: Luke 10:31-32 mentions that first a priest and then a Levite saw the man and passed by on the other side.

quiz.q: The criminal who was released instead of Jesus was _____.
quiz.solution: The crowd chose Barabbas, a notorious prisoner/insurrectionist, to be released according to the custom of the feast.

quiz.q: Paul was known as the 'Apostle to the _____'.
quiz.solution: Paul received a specific commission to preach the Gospel to the non-Jewish world (Gentiles).

quiz.q: The specific sin of the people of Sodom and Gomorrah according to Genesis was _____.
quiz.solution: The cities were destroyed because their outcry reached heaven and their sin was very grave.

quiz.q: Parable of Sower seed means:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Word of God.

quiz.q: Cornelius was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Centurion.

quiz.q: Ruth's mother-in-law:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Naomi.

quiz.q: Nehemiah rebuilt:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Walls of Jerusalem.

quiz.q: The Holy Spirit descended on the apostles on the day of:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Pentecost.

quiz.q: Who was thrown into the lion's den?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Daniel.

quiz.q: Who was the 'voice crying in the wilderness'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: John the Baptist.

quiz.q: The first miracle of Jesus was at:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Cana.

quiz.q: The Parable of the Good Samaritan teaches:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Neighborliness.

quiz.q: Daniel was thrown into:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: The lion's den.

quiz.q: Deborah, the prophetess, was a judge who helped Israel defeat...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: The Canaanites under Jabin.

quiz.q: Paul and Silas were imprisoned in Philippi for...
options: Casting out a spirit of divination from a slave girl
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Casting out a spirit of divination from a slave girl.

quiz.q: Who sold his birthright for a plate of pottage?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Esau.

quiz.q: The wife of Ahab who persecuted Elijah was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Jezebel.

quiz.q: The Great Commission is to:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Make disciples of all nations.

quiz.q: Zacchaeus climbed a:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Sycamore tree.

quiz.q: Justification by Faith is taught in:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Romans.

quiz.q: Esther saved the Jews from:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Haman.

quiz.q: Fruit of Spirit:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Love.

quiz.q: Prodigal son:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Repentance.

quiz.q: The first son of Adam and Eve was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Cain.

quiz.q: The Israelites crossed the?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Red Sea.

quiz.q: "As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord" was said by?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Joshua.

quiz.q: The Northern Kingdom was called?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Israel.

quiz.q: Esther became queen to?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Save her people from Haman.

quiz.q: Habakkuk questioned God about?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: The prosperity of the wicked.

quiz.q: The Babylonian captivity lasted?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: 70 years.

quiz.q: The gifts of the Magi were?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Gold, Frankincense, and Myrrh.

quiz.q: The story of the Prodigal Son teaches about?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: God's forgiveness.

quiz.q: Jesus rose from the dead on the?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: 3rd day.

quiz.q: Which Gospel emphasizes Jesus as the "Word"?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: John.

quiz.q: Cornelius was the?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: First Gentile convert.
